manifest.name: Unclean leader election
manifest.description: RF=2, min.insync=1, unclean.leader.election.enable=true. Follower b2 is cut off and drops out of the ISR. Then leader b1 dies: with no ISR member left the controller elects out-of-sync b2 and acknowledged records are lost. Set uncleanLeaderElection=false to see the partition stay offline instead.
